rawMessage: In multi-icon solutions across all HPE products, OCA CLIC validation attributes child container/chassis service and configuration errors to Item 0100/01 (the first line in the solution tree, Rule 81039677) regardless of where the error actually resides. Never assume the first line is the root cause; inspect child icon containers directly.
ruleUpdate: When Rule 81039677 occurs on multi-icon tenders, trace errors to individual child icon containers instead of modifying the root BOM item.

rawMessage: Across all HPE configurations mixing rack servers (DL380) with modular chassis (Synergy frames) or storage (Alletra), NEVER check 'Apply to all icons inside solution' for support or deployment services. solutionType: Universal HPE BTO / Smart Choice vs CTO Guidance
ruleUpdate: HPE Smart Choice (xxxxxx-xx5) and regional BTO SKUs are pre-configured distributor builds, NOT CTO (-B21) configurables: (1) Never infer unstated internal factory SKUs from the short description alone (QuickSpecs notes BTO models ship with a pre-selected primary NIC without naming its exact SKU in the title, and HPE forbids factory integration of extra options into pre-configured models). (2) Never treat an OCA Customize BOM export of a -xx5 SKU as proof of factory-included parts: OCA opens Smart Choice SKUs as blank shells (0 CPU/RAM/PSU errors), auto-selects separately priced CTO menu defaults on top of the base SKU, and fails CLIC with Rule 81016667 (UNBUILDABLE: configure/quote/order via Distributor webstore or iQuote Universal, Warning 81400509). (3) Validation & reasoning steps: verify suffix (-xx5 BTO/Smart Choice vs -B21 CTO in chassis_map.json / *_Catalog.json); if CTO is desired, map to -B21 CTO chassis and run the canonical CTO evaluation/CLIC path; if exact Smart Choice factory contents are needed, consult HPE Smart Choice Supplemental QuickSpecs (e.g. a50009219enw), iQuote Universal, or an authorized distributor.
rawMessage: Universal workflow & on-demand validation lesson for HPE Smart Choice (xxxxxx-xx5) / BTO vs CTO: CTO QuickSpecs and *_Catalog.json exclude Smart Choice SKUs. Clicking Customize in OCA on Smart Choice opens an incomplete shell that injects priced menu add-ons and rejects via CLIC Rule 81016667 / Warning 81400509 (directing partners to iQuote Universal or distributor webstores). Validate factory-included Smart Choice contents via Supplemental QuickSpecs / iQuote Universal / distributor, or pivot to a -B21 CTO chassis for customizable HPE OCA/CLIC validation.

scopeEvidence: Verified against live HPE OCA Solution-Level CLIC Check (#eo_nav_li_0), Summary Issues and Approvals, and exported CLIC_Advice Excel workbook (Information / Advice_Text / BOM sheets).
solutionType: Universal HPE OCA CLIC Check & Advice Triage
ruleUpdate: For any full HPE solution in OCA: (1) Run CLIC Check at the Global Solution Level (top breadcrumb #eo_nav_li_0) rather than only at a child frame/node (Partial CLIC Check), and click Download Advice (#_clic_download_excel) to inspect every row of the Advice_Text and BOM sheets alongside Solution Summary Messages/Issues. (2) Triage CLIC severities properly: Unbuildables and Process control (P+ in Advice_Text) MUST be fixed or formally exception-approved before quoting/ordering. Plain Error rows do not automatically break buildability and may sometimes be ignored, but MUST still be read carefully to verify whether a required action/quantity is missing or already met elsewhere in the solution. Warnings (e.g., PSU C13-to-C20 jumper cables for C19 PDUs, redundant VC FC licenses) must also be reviewed for physical deployment completeness. (3) Note that CLIC Advice Information sheet counts may underreport Warning rows compared to Advice_Text and CLIC Advice BOM may omit icon-level service lines outside the hardware container.
rawMessage: Universal OCA CLIC workflow & severity triage lesson: Run CLIC Check at Global Solution level (#eo_nav_li_0) and Download Advice. Must fix Unbuildables and Process control (P+) errors. Plain Errors may not break buildability and can sometimes be ignored after verifying whether any action is needed; read Warnings too for physical readiness (e.g., power jumper cables, licensing symmetry) and inspect Advice_Text directly.
